title: Hiring Art Tatum and Simp Green for the Three Deuces
summary: On Sam Beer's vacation trip Zutty hired Simp Green, a singer-dancer, and went to Cleveland to bring in Art Tatum, who earned a hundred dollars a week for the first time.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: And we went to Annapolis and that's when we got Simp Green and we went to Cleveland and hired Art Tatum.
Yes?
Yes. Art Tatum, that's the first time he played in Chicago.
Well I'll be darned!
At the old Three Dancers.
And you brought them back to work with you or....
Yes, to work in the same spot I was. Because they were getting a lot more money than I was getting. I think that's the first time Art Tatum made a hundred dollars a week. I think it was, see.
But of course, you were band the house then?
Yes, I was a house band, yes. And Tatum, naturally he was an outstanding guy.
Well what was Slim Green he sang didn't he?
Simp Green they called him.
Simp?
Simp. Like he's simple.
Yes?
And he was in at Indianapolis.
Well what did he do?
He sang and danced and played a little triple tempo you know.
Yes. He was more of an entertainer?
Oh yes. He was really a good entertainer. And he used to sing 'Cocky, Cocky Tales for Two'.
I can remember that. He made a record of that. It was on Decca, I remember now. Yes. Well then, what were the circumstances of Roy coming in?
